Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Suresh Rathore. I am a 75-year-old software engineer living in Pune. Radhika Pai gave me a cheque for Rs 29,70,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 87072 32389 or email suresh.rathore@example.in.
